title: A preference and a constraint come back for later questions that share none of their words

turns.user: Quick context before we start: I prefer small PRs, under 400 changed lines each.

agent_captures.quote: I prefer small PRs, under 400 changed lines each

turns.agent_reply: Got it: I will keep pull requests small, under 400 changed lines each. Larger changes get split.

turns.user: Also, the public REST API must stay backwards compatible until v3 ships.

agent_captures.quote: the public REST API must stay backwards compatible until v3 ships

turns.agent_reply: Understood: no breaking changes to the public REST API until v3. Removals and renames wait for that release.

turns.user: I want to rename customer_id to account_id in the JSON we return from GET /orders to partners. Anything to watch out for?
turns.agent_reply: Yes: partners read that JSON, and the rename would break them while the API has to stay backwards compatible until v3. Add account_id next to customer_id, mark customer_id as deprecated in the OpenAPI spec, and remove it in v3.

turns.user: Fine. Break the move of the whole orders module to the new ORM into pieces I can review.
turns.agent_reply: Here is a split into five pieces of under 400 changed lines each: models, read paths, write paths, data migrations, and removal of the old ORM code. The GET /orders response stays the same in every step.
